scope: Parent contextual language reference for final independent adjudication;no target/source edits
rule: Do not turn an allowed idiomatic punctuation variant into an objective defect. This does not waive commas in actual subordinate clauses.

cases.priorFinding: Automatically requires a comma inside то что надо
cases.authorAdjudication: Reject mandatory change in the approving fixed-expression reading
cases.primaryReferenceSummary: The language helpdesk permits omission in an evaluative idiomatic meaning and recognizes context-dependent normative variants,so mandatory punctuation cannot be inferred from this substring alone.
cases.parentAssessment: This approving exclamation can use the idiomatic reading;retain the existing valid variant rather than polish for taste. Fresh independent reviewer must inspect complete source/target/context and the actual author reason.
cases.counterexampleBoundary: A referential subordinate clause still requires its appropriate punctuation;no global no-comma exemption is introduced.
